text: Recognize and embrace your identity as a son or daughter of God. Let your desire to grow closer to Him guide every lesson and experience you encounter today.
Every day is an opportunity to learn and grow with God. When we live with Him at our center, even the smallest moments become full of profound meaning and inspiration.
Your spirit is formed by how you live each day. Every thought, word, and action shapes your character.
Do not try to escape from challenges. Instead, choose to embrace them and overcome them, as facing what is difficult is the best way to prepare yourself for life.
True potential often comes through being pushed to your limits. Just as a coach helps an athlete reach new heights, challenges help you discover your own unlimited potential.
Character building and spiritual education are the most important foundations of human achievement. When you focus on these, all other aspects of your life will naturally develop.
Moral courage is the hardest kind of courage to find. It comes from having deep conviction in your actions and knowing that you are following the truth of God.
Cultivate self-mastery through simple and consistent actions. Even a small habit can strengthen your personal discipline when it is rooted in a clear purpose and connected to God.
Purpose and motivation define what you do. As sons and daughters of God, we should always keep Him at the root of our goals and our intentions in life.
Mistakes and shortcomings are natural parts of any journey toward growth. Do not give up when you stumble; instead, support one another and treat every struggle as a learning moment.
Stop comparing your path to the paths of others. God created you with a unique design and purpose, and true joy begins when you embrace the specific identity He gave you.
Sincere devotion means putting your whole heart into every act. It is not the size of the action that matters, but the sincerity of heart and love behind your offering.
Self-mastery is achieved through humility and gratitude. A spiritually mature person seeks to understand the heart and will of God, living as a true son or daughter.
True freedom comes when you align your will with the will of God. By placing His vision above your own impulses, you discover your highest potential and your true self.
Wounds easily disappear in the presence of true love. Even enemies melt away without a trace in the presence of true love.
True love is a heart that gives and gives and wants to continue giving. True love is a love that even forgets that it already gave love and gives love again.
When a person has a full stomach the world seems big, but to a hungry person a grain of rice is bigger than the earth.
No matter how fierce the beating or terrible the environment, a person can endure if he carries a definite purpose in his heart.
When we have a heart of love we can open anyone's heart.

A person of good character must be accustomed to rising to a high position and then quickly falling to a low position. Most people are afraid of falling from a high position, so they do everything they can to preserve it. However, water that does not flow becomes stale.
Even in the most difficult situations we should maintain our composure, demonstrate warmth toward others, be self-reliant, and adapt well to any circumstance.
A wise person will place hope in the future and continue to move forward, no matter how difficult it may be. A foolish person will throw away his future for the sake of immediate happiness.
Whatever the time or place, love is most important.
Before seeking to dominate the universe, first perfect your ability to dominate yourself.

I might be a tree that is buffeted by the wind and rain and scorched by fire, but I would never be a tree that burns and dies. Even a branch that has been scorched will have new buds when the spring comes.
If I continue on my way with humility and strong conviction, the day will surely come when the world will understand the value of what I do.
The most important thing is to think of life as precious.
People who cannot respect their own tradition are destined to fail.

If I receive a favor, it is important to me that I repay it. If I cannot meet the person who did this for me, it is important for me to remember that person in my heart. I need to live with the sincere thought that I will repay the person by helping someone else.

No matter how much love may overflow, the love in the family will never go dry. This is because it is received from God. The love we receive from God is such that we can continue to dig it out but never see the bottom.
The family is the school of love where people can learn how to love each other and live together in peace, and it is the training center where we practice how to build a palace of peace in the world.
The essence of love is to cast aside any thought of having others live for one's self; it is to live for the sake of others and give for the whole.
There is no wall that cannot be scaled and no dream that cannot be realized when we share our love with a sincere heart.
Suffering difficulties causes one to have a heart that sheds tears and cries, but it is through this type of heart that one can receive God's blessing. God comes to a heart that is soaked with tears.
We were all created to be great men and women. God did not send us into this world without purpose.
Nothing exists for its own sake. That is not how God created the world. It is an axiom of Heaven that every being lives for the sake of its partner.
When we realize that our life is not ours alone but is meant to be for the sake of the other, we begin to follow a path different from the one we were on.
Happiness is always waiting for us. The reason we can't get happiness is that our own desires block the way. As long as our eyes are fixed on our desires, they cannot see the path we should follow.
Just as singing to yourself will not make you happy, there is no joy without a partner. Even the smallest and most trivial thing can bring you happiness when you do it for another.
To realize that we exist for the sake of others is the great achievement that changes our lives.

When you wake up in the morning, greet God, and then make a promise to fulfill your goal for the day to God. Also, when you sleep at night, report about your day to God and then sleep with an attitude of gratitude.
Each and every one of us was born miraculously from God. How deeply does God love me, unique throughout the whole world?
We should always live our lives centered on God. When you are with family and friends, even when you are alone, you should always live with God in mind.
Just like anyone is sad while lonely, God also feels sad when He is lonely. When I live together with God, He is very happy.
God is always living with us in our hearts. When we live listening to the voice of our conscience, God is always together with us.
Food was all created by God investing his full heart of love. Whenever you eat, we should not forget our gratitude to God.
God loves all human beings. When we love and care for each other, God feels joy.

If you hurt someone, you will also feel pain in your heart. That is because God who is inside you is also feeling sadness. During those times, you should love that person even more than you hurt them.
Working your hardest to accomplish something is cultivating and developing yourself which God created. When God looks at you, God will also feel inspired.
Everyone was born inheriting good qualities from God. When you look at people, try to find their good points more than their bad points.

We should not forget our gratitude to God even for the things which we may take for granted. The fact that right now, you have a family, eat food, and can live your day healthily, is all happiness given to us by God.
For the little bird to survive, God made food and trees to rest on. If that’s so, how many things has God made for my sake?
We may dislike it when it rains, if it didn’t rain, what would we do without that water? Even though we may dislike some things, something important may be hidden.
Before you become an adult, you have to know what kind of person God is. That is the most important thing in life.

No matter how many people there are, there are no two people who are the same. God gave every single person wonderful qualities which only that person has. That’s why you should live with pride in yourself.
Saying casual greetings like “How are you?” or “Thank you” with sincerity can warm people’s hearts. You are telling them “I think you are important”.
Flowers work hard to bloom beautifully to make people happy. We should work our hardest to live a good life to make God happy.
What kind of person is True Father? True Father dedicated his whole life living in order to make God and all of humanity happy. True Father is a role model for all of us.
If we don’t hate anyone, do not lie, and do not hide anything, trying to live resembling God, our hearts will always be clear.
For what purpose do we study God’s Words? So that we can grow into mature people who resemble God.

In everyday life, we should try to talk with God in our hearts. God and human beings are in a parent-child relationship so when you are happy, inspired, sad or worried, you can talk about many different things.
Your smile will naturally give joy to people’s hearts. Simply living with a smile on your face is “Living for the sake of others”.
When you fail at something, you should not stop there. By working even harder and overcoming that, you can grow into a truly mature person.
We should always live with a grateful heart. In any moment, God is always giving love to us.
When you live everyday thinking, “What kind of joy is waiting for me today?” with excitement, you will gain more energy and God must also feel so much happiness seeing you.
When you do something good when no one is watching, God will remember what you did.

More than temporary happiness you may feel from material things, the eternal happiness you can feel in your heart is far more precious. When you eventually go to the spirit world, what you can take with you is a heart of joy.

There are times when the people who lie or cheat may succeed temporarily, but that will not last long. People who live good lives with honesty while living for the sake of others, will definitely succeed in the end.
In order to live with smiles in our lives, we should always be grateful. When we are grateful for the simple things like the air which God gave us to breathe, we can live with joy.
God made so many different kinds of food thinking about the human body. Eating a balanced diet without being picky will naturally make us healthy.
